# Distribution logo notices

The SVG path data in `app/public/img/distros/` matches Simple Icons revision
`cd796c98565fc466923fc1128b962e133fa3c612`:
https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/cd796c98565fc466923fc1128b962e133fa3c612
The files in this project include a title and explicit fill colour. Matching
path data does not prove the source history of every file. Simple Icons warns
that individual icons may have their own licence or trademark conditions:
https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/cd796c98565fc466923fc1128b962e133fa3c612/DISCLAIMER.md

The project owner has confirmed the rights needed to use the logos. The
following references and attribution information are retained for recipients;
the marks remain the property of their respective owners and their appearance
here does not imply endorsement.

- **Debian:** the Simple Icons metadata identifies CC BY-SA 3.0 and points to
  https://www.debian.org/logos/. Debian attributes its open-use logo to
  Software in the Public Interest. The licence text is `CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt`.
- **Rocky Linux:** the Simple Icons metadata identifies CC BY-SA 4.0 and cites
  the Rocky Linux branding repository, whose root licence reports BSD-3-Clause:
  https://github.com/rocky-linux/branding/blob/94e97dd30b87d909cc4f6a6838a2926f77f9ac47/logo/src/icon-black.svg
  Rocky Linux marks are owned by the Rocky Enterprise Software Foundation.
  The CC BY-SA 4.0 text is `CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt`.
- **Fedora:** https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/project/brand/;
  Fedora and its logo are trademarks of Red Hat, Inc.
- **CentOS:** https://www.centos.org/legal/trademarks/;
  CentOS marks are trademarks of Red Hat, Inc.
- **AlmaLinux:** https://almalinux.org/p/the-almalinux-os-trademark-usage-policy/
- **Ubuntu:** https://ubuntu.com/legal/intellectual-property-policy
- **Proxmox:** https://proxmox.com/en/about/company-details/media-kit

This notice records upstream metadata and the owner's confirmation; it does not
purport to resolve the different Rocky Linux metadata or replace the applicable
permissions, attribution and trademark conditions.
